svg.title: AI Type Selection Framework
svg.desc: Input data, such as raw data, documents, images, transactions and logs, branches into four AI approaches. To generate new content, use generative AI (LLM or diffusion models). To classify or label, use discriminative ML (random forest or SVM). To predict a number, use regression ML (linear or neural). To surface relevant items, use recommendation (collaborative filtering).
svg.text: Choose the AI approach by what the business problem needs the output to be.
